scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:electron: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend,electron -c cyan,magenta,blue "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run build --workspace=packages/electron && electron packages/electron"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=packages/frontend && npm run build --workspace=packages/backend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=packages/shared && npm run test --workspace=packages/backend && npm run test --workspace=packages/frontend
